title: Transfer Fcn Real Zero
text: Implement discrete-time transfer function that has real zero and no pole, 1 input, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Integer rounding mode} sets Rounding mode for fixed-point operations; {Zero (in Z plane)} sets the zero, {Initial condition for previous input}, {Input processing} sets the sample- or frame-based processing Elements and {Saturate to max or min when overflows occur} sets the method of overflow action. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Initial condition for previous input
params.values: Initial condition for previous input 0.0 (default) | scalar

params.name: Input processing
params.values: Specify sample- or frame-based processing Elements as channels (sample based) (default) | Columns as channels (frame based)

params.name: Integer rounding mode
params.values: Rounding mode for fixed-point operations Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Simplest | Zero

params.name: Saturate to max or min when overflows occur
params.values: Method of overflow action off (default) | on
